name: DataImport
harvested_from: laravel-vue-template (built generic 2026-08-24; the counterpart to modules/Exports)
description: Spreadsheet imports with a column-mapping wizard. A project registers named import targets with their fields and validation; users upload a CSV, map its headers onto those fields, see a dry-run of what would happen, then commit. Rows that fail validation are reported per row rather than failing the batch.
